title: Concept: Device trusted while unverified
description: A trusted device flag set on a session that was never verified in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The flag decides whether the next login skips the second factor, so trusting an unverified device quietly removes the step-up check.
applicability: Deployments that render a trusted device flag set on a session that was never verified into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The flag decides whether the next login skips the second factor, so trusting an unverified device quietly removes the step-up check.
